keysEdit.modelsDisabledForType: Models field is disabled for this key type
keysEdit.allowedRoutesHint: List of allowed routes for the key (comma-separated). Can be specific routes (e.g., '/chat/completions') or route patterns (e.g., 'llm_api_routes', 'management_routes', '/keys/*'). Leave empty to allow all routes.
keysEdit.allowedRoutesPlaceholder: Enter allowed routes (comma-separated). Special values: llm_api_routes, management_routes. Examples: llm_api_routes, /chat/completions, /keys/*. Leave empty to allow all routes
keysEdit.softBudgetPlaceholder: Get alerts when spend crosses this value, without blocking requests
keysEdit.budgetWindowsHint: Set multiple independent budget windows (e.g., hourly 10,000 tokens AND monthly 200,000 tokens). Each window tracks spend separately and resets on its own schedule.
keysEdit.budgetFallbacksHint: When a model exceeds its per-model budget, requests automatically reroute to fallback models instead of failing
keysEdit.throttleHint: When this key exceeds its max budget, throttle its TPM/RPM to the globally configured percentage instead of blocking access entirely. Requires budget_exceeded_throttle_percentage in litellm_settings and a TPM/RPM limit on the key.
keysEdit.promptCachingHint: Automatically add prompt caching breakpoints (cache_control markers) to requests made with this key, cutting input cost on repeated prompts. Applies to Anthropic and Bedrock Claude models; requests that already set their own cache_control markers are left untouched.
keysEdit.perTagRateLimitsHint: Scope rate limits to a request tag so each tag (e.g. a cell or group) gets its own RPM counter. Requests without a matching tag fall back to the key-level limit.
keysEdit.disableGlobalGuardrailsHint: When enabled, this key will bypass any guardrails configured to run on every request (global guardrails)
keysEdit.policiesHint: Apply policies to this key to control guardrails and other settings
keysEdit.promptsPremiumHint: Setting prompts by key is a premium feature
keysEdit.promptsPremiumPlaceholder: Premium feature - Upgrade to set prompts by key
keysEdit.accessGroupsHint: Assign access groups to this key. Access groups control which models, MCP servers, and agents this key can use
keysEdit.passThroughPremiumHint: Setting allowed pass through routes by key is a premium feature
keysEdit.passThroughPremiumPlaceholder: Premium feature - Upgrade to set allowed pass through routes by key
keysEdit.passThroughPlaceholder: Select or enter allowed pass through routes
keysEdit.mcpServersPlaceholder: Select MCP servers or access groups (optional)
keysEdit.organizationHint: The organization this key belongs to. Selecting an organization filters the available teams.
keysEdit.organizationLocked: Organization is locked because this key belongs to a project
keysEdit.teamLocked: Team is locked because this key belongs to a project

teams.pageSubtitle: Manage teams, members, and their access to models and budgets
teams.deleteWarning: Warning: This team has {count} keys associated with it. Deleting the team will also delete all associated keys, along with any models created for this team. This action is irreversible.
teams.deleteMessage: Are you sure you want to delete this team, all its keys, and any models created for it? This action cannot be undone.
teams.organizationHint: Organizations can have multiple teams. Learn more about the user management hierarchy
teams.organizationSingleHint: You can only create teams within this organization
teams.organizationSelectNotice: Please select an organization to create a team for. You can only create teams within organizations where you are an admin.
teams.modelsHint: These are the models that your selected team has access to. Leave empty to grant no models directly, e.g. when the team gets its models from access groups
teams.metadataDescription: Values are saved as text. Enter JSON for typed values, e.g. 3, true, or '{"region": "us"}'.
teams.teamIdDescription: ID of the team you want to create. If not provided, it will be generated automatically.
teams.teamMemberBudgetHint: This is the individual budget for a user in the team.
teams.teamMemberKeyDurationHint: Set a limit to the duration of a team member's key. Format: 30s (seconds), 30m (minutes), 30h (hours), 30d (days), 1mo (month)
teams.teamMemberRpmLimitHint: The RPM (Requests Per Minute) limit for individual team members
teams.teamMemberTpmLimitHint: The TPM (Tokens Per Minute) limit for individual team members
teams.secretManagerPremiumDesc: Enter secret manager configuration as a JSON object.
teams.secretManagerFreeDesc: Premium feature - Upgrade to manage secret manager settings.
teams.guardrailsDescription: Select existing guardrails or enter new ones
teams.disableGlobalGuardrailsHint: When enabled, this team will bypass any guardrails configured to run on every request (global guardrails)
teams.disableGlobalGuardrailsPremiumDesc: Bypass global guardrails for this team
teams.disableGlobalGuardrailsFreeDesc: Premium feature - Upgrade to disable global guardrails by team
teams.policiesDocsHint: Apply policies to this team to control guardrails and other settings
teams.policiesDescription: Select existing policies or enter new ones
teams.accessGroupsHint: Assign access groups to this team. Access groups control which models, MCP servers, and agents this team can use
teams.accessGroupsDescription: Select access groups to assign to this team
teams.allowedVectorStoresHint: Select which vector stores this team can access by default. Leave empty for access to all vector stores
teams.allowedVectorStoresDescription: Select vector stores this team can access. Leave empty for access to all vector stores
teams.passThroughPremiumHint: Premium feature - Upgrade to set allowed pass through routes
teams.passThroughNonAdminHint: Only proxy admins can set allowed pass through routes
teams.allowedMcpServersHint: Select which MCP servers or access groups this team can access
teams.allowedMcpServersDescription: Select MCP servers or access groups this team can access
teams.mcpPlaceholder: Select MCP servers or access groups (optional)
teams.allowedAgentsHint: Select which agents or access groups this team can access
teams.allowedAgentsDescription: Select agents or access groups this team can access
teams.allowedSearchToolsHint: Select which search tools this team can access. Leave empty to allow all search tools.
teams.allowedSearchToolsDescription: Restrict which configured search tools keys on this team may call.
teams.searchToolsPlaceholder: Select search tools (optional, empty = all allowed)
teams.allowedSkillsHint: Enabled skills are visible to every team. Grant disabled (private) Claude Code plugins to this team here.
teams.allowedSkillsDescription: Private skills keys on this team may see in the Claude Code marketplace.
teams.modelAliasesDescription: Create custom aliases for models that can be used by team members in API calls. This allows you to create shortcuts for specific models.
